279608469.description:
Natural Fossil Collection Trilobite Ammonite Shell Dendritic Limestone Specimens
This collection includes a fossil trilobite (Elrathia Kingii) from the mid-Cambrian period, approximately 550 million years old, contained in a plastic sleeve with an informational card. Also included is a polished ammonite fossil cabochon showing a spiral structure, a fossilized shell embedded in stone likely from a prehistoric marine organism, and two large pieces of dendritic limestone featuring manganese oxide mineral dendrite patterns. The specimens display natural coloration and textures, with varying states of preservation and polish. Suitable for collectors, educational use, or decorative display.
